# Claude Code Guide

GitHub automation and issue forms live here.

Start with:

- `.github/labels.yml`
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/autocomplete-beta-feedback.yml`

Rules:

- Keep beta feedback structured enough for agents to triage.
- Do not ask for raw typed text, prompts, screenshots, document names, URLs, or recipients by default.
- Keep labels aligned with the issue template and private beta docs.
- Treat issue form wording as user-facing product copy.
